description: This source file implements the core logic for the 'git shortlog' command, handling parsing, commit processing, and output formatting related to summarizing commits by author or other groupings.

classes.name: struct shortlog
classes.description: Holds the state and options for generating a shortlog summary, including lists of authors, formatting options, and grouping settings.

methods.name: int compare_by_counter(const void * a1,const void * a2)
methods.description: Comparator function for sorting by commit count in descending order.

methods.name: int compare_by_list(const void * a1,const void * a2)
methods.description: Comparator function for sorting authors by the size of their commit list.

methods.name: void insert_one_record(struct shortlog * log,const char * ident,const char * oneline)
methods.description: Inserts a commit record into the shortlog, updating counts or adding the commit message based on options.

methods.name: int parse_ident(struct shortlog * log,struct strbuf * out,const char * in)
methods.description: Parses a string containing author or committer identification into a normalized name and email.

methods.name: void read_from_stdin(struct shortlog * log)
methods.description: Reads commit info from standard input, typically used when no revision range is specified.

methods.name: void insert_records_from_trailers(struct shortlog * log,struct strset * dups,struct commit * commit,struct pretty_print_context * ctx,const char * oneline)
methods.description: Extracts trailer information from commit messages to include in the shortlog.

methods.name: int shortlog_needs_dedup(const struct shortlog * log)
methods.description: Determines whether deduplication is necessary based on the current shortlog settings.

methods.name: void insert_records_from_format(struct shortlog * log,struct strset * dups,struct commit * commit,struct pretty_print_context * ctx,const char * oneline)
methods.description: Inserts commit messages based on specified formatting options.

methods.name: void shortlog_add_commit(struct shortlog * log,struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Processes an individual commit, extracting relevant info for the shortlog.

methods.name: void get_from_rev(struct rev_info * rev,struct shortlog * log)
methods.description: Walks through revision history to process commits for the shortlog.

methods.name: int parse_uint(char const ** arg,int comma,int defval)
methods.description: Parses an unsigned integer value from a string argument, used for formatting options.

methods.name: int parse_wrap_args(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses line-wrapping options for output formatting.

methods.name: int parse_group_option(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses group-by options for grouping commits in the shortlog.

methods.name: void shortlog_init(struct shortlog * log)
methods.description: Initializes the shortlog structure and loads necessary configurations.

methods.name: void shortlog_finish_setup(struct shortlog * log)
methods.description: Finalizes the setup by preparing the list of formats and groupings.

methods.name: int cmd_shortlog(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main command function, handles argument parsing, revision walking, and outputting the shortlog.

methods.name: void add_wrapped_shortlog_msg(struct strbuf * sb,const char * s,const struct shortlog * log)
methods.description: Adds a wrapped message line to a string buffer, respecting formatting options.

methods.name: void shortlog_output(struct shortlog * log)
methods.description: Outputs the generated shortlog to the specified file pointer, sorting and formatting as needed.
